Troubleshooting · 24/50 · graphics

Alpha channel lost

Failure signal

A alpha channel lost condition is reported or detected during graphics.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for graphics does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Inspect channel count, codec support, premultiplication and export interpretation.

Corrective action

Export a supported alpha codec with documented straight or premultiplied handling.

Prevention

Add this verification to the graphics gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
